title: henckelia elongata
intro: Henckelia elongata, commonly known as the 'Dragon Flower', is a plant species native to the Himalayan region. It is valued for its medicinal properties, which include health benefits such as anti-inflammatory and antioxidant effects, helping to reduce stress and improve overall well-being. The therapeutic actions of Henckelia elongata include its ability to act as an adaptogen, promoting balance in the body and enhancing immune function. The plant contains bioactive constituents such as flavonoids, alkaloids, and phenolic compounds, which are responsible for its medicinal properties.
